hooks.command: command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "code-quality-guard: uv is required to run this hook; install it from https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/" >&2; exit 1; }; hook="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/code-quality-guard.py"; uv run --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" --script --python '>=3.14' --no-project "$hook"; rc=$?; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && exit 0; uv sync --project "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" --script "$hook" --python '>=3.14' --offline >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit "$rc"; printf '{"systemMessage": "denubis-hook-code-quality-guard: code-quality-guard could not run (uv exit %d); run /denubis-00-getting-started:setup to check and repair plugin environments"}\n' "$rc"; exit 0
